model_labels.approximate: approximate: European model on an American-style contract

note: Surface frame rows. Quotes are BSM midpoints of stated 6-decimal sigma (4-decimal bid/ask, spread 0.002), chain records are exactly the M1 ChainContract field set. Expected forward within 1e-6, ATM IV within 1e-4, counts exact. Per-expiry status, reason and field values are asserted under items.expiries (shape is an authoring choice, see AUTHORING_NOTES defect D-01). The gate order of M1 is no_quote, excluded_condition, invalid_quote, crossed_market, locked_market, stale_quote, then style gates; a contract counts under its first failing reason.
